n = int(input())

a = 0
b = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    p = x * i // y
    q = p + 1
    temp = abs(x * b - a * y) * i
    t1 = b * abs(x * i - y * p)
    t2 = b * abs(x * i - y * q)
    if t1 < temp:
        a = p
        b = i
        temp = t1
    if t2 < temp:
        a = q
        b = i
        temp = t2

print(f"{a}/{b}")
